description:
An exceptional opportunity awaits a dedicated Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential role offers a chance to make a significant impact on patient care and operational excellence within a supportive environment. We are seeking a visionary leader committed to upholding the highest standards of quality and compliance.

As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and success of the facility, ensuring the delivery of outstanding patient care, efficient operations, and a positive work culture. This is a chance to guide a compassionate team and contribute to the well-being of residents, with a competitive salary reflecting your expertise and leadership.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing facility
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Demonstrated ability to manage operations, finances, and staff effectively
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA. This vital role involves ensuring accurate and timely completion of the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, which are crucial for resident care planning and regulatory compliance. You will play a key part in maintaining the highest standards of quality care for our residents.As an MDS Coordinator, you will collaborate closely with the interdisciplinary team to develop comprehensive care plans that reflect each resident's needs. Your expertise in MDS 3.0 and regulatory guidelines will be essential in optimizing reimbursement and ensuring adherence to all federal and state requirements. This is a full-time opportunity to make a significant impact within a supportive environment.This full-time position offers an annual salary ranging from $65,000 to $75,000, commensurate with your experience and qualifications. Join a team committed to excellence and providing compassionate care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Proven experience as an MDS Coordinator, preferably within a skilled nursing facility.
In-depth knowledge of MDS 3.0 and associated federal and state regulations.
RAC-CT certification is highly preferred.
Exceptional organizational, assessment, and communication skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $65,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description: We are seeking dedicated Full-time Licensed Practical Nurses (LPNs) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Magee, MS. This vital role involves providing compassionate and skilled nursing care to residents during the evening and night shifts.As an LPN, you will be instrumental in ensuring the well-being of our residents, working a consistent 7 PM to 7 AM schedule with a 3/2 split. This is an excellent opportunity for LPNs looking for a stable full-time position with competitive hourly pay.
requirements: Current and valid Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) license in the state of Mississippi.
Minimum of one year of experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting preferred.
Ability to work full-time evening/night shifts (7 PM - 7 AM) on a 3/2 split schedule.
Current CPR certification.
Strong clinical assessment and documentation skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $25-$28 based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Vice President - Client Services to join a leading global solutions provider. This pivotal leadership role is responsible for cultivating robust client relationships, driving operational effectiveness, and ensuring sustained revenue growth and client retention across a diverse portfolio.
The successful candidate will be a strategic leader with a proven ability to manage large-scale client engagements within a Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) environment. Key responsibilities include developing and maintaining strong client partnerships, overseeing service delivery to ensure satisfaction, identifying new business opportunities, and managing contracts and service level agreements.
This role offers an exciting opportunity to lead and mentor a dedicated team, collaborate with various internal departments, and contribute significantly to the organization's success. If you are a results-oriented professional with a passion for client success and BPO expertise, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field
10+ years of experience in client services or account management
At least 5 years in a leadership position within the BPO industry
Proven track record of managing multi-million dollar client portfolios
Strong understanding of BPO operations and industry best practices
